The independent projection-support inverse transform has total absolute numerator 3,184, yielding 199/32. Package check_asm4.py directly recomputes all 65,536 ambient characters and compares frequency_spectrum.csv (512 rows) and support_masks.csv (42 rows) against exact enumeration; inspected source and certificate shape. Fourier translation averaging proves no arbitrary real/complex projection onto the range has lower endpoint norm. No higher ASM order inferred.
